method.unit: one navigation in a fresh browser context followed by a page-specific verified interaction trace
method.order: complete randomized blocks; one sample from every page/profile cell per block
method.cache: disabled through CDP; service workers blocked; a new context is used for every sample
method.transport: loopback HTTP; documents and JavaScript served with deterministic gzip level 9; Brotli-11 sizes computed offline
method.coverage: V8 precise block coverage, split into initial-load and interaction phases; UTF-16 offsets converted to UTF-8 bytes
method.heap: Runtime.getHeapUsage immediately after an explicit HeapProfiler.collectGarbage
method.confidenceIntervals: deterministic 95% percentile bootstrap of the median (5000 resamples)
method.externalResources: fulfilled locally with HTTP 204; only fixture HTML and linked RSJS JavaScript are measured
